name: Sylvan-Polje

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws impact-scarred wastelands, patient as erosion itself.
The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
For traders, silicon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
